title: VPN Connection Fails After MFA Approval
content: User reported that VPN authentication succeeded after MFA approval, but the tunnel did not establish. Support verified the user account was active, confirmed the VPN client was one minor version behind, flushed DNS, restarted the client, and tested from a second network. Resolution was to update the VPN client and clear the cached profile. Root cause was a stale VPN profile created before the gateway certificate rotation.
expected_questions: Why does VPN fail after MFA approval?
What should support check when VPN tunnel creation fails?

title: Failed Backup Runbook
content: Purpose: restore failed scheduled backups for PostgreSQL services. Prerequisites: database read access, backup job dashboard access, and permission to rerun the job. Procedure: confirm the failed job id, inspect storage capacity, verify database connectivity, rerun the backup with the standard profile, and validate that the backup artifact exists. Rollback is not required for a failed backup rerun. Escalate to Data Platform if storage errors continue after capacity is available.
expected_questions: How do I respond to a failed PostgreSQL backup?
What validation is needed after rerunning backup?

title: Multi-Factor Authentication Policy
content: All internal users must use multi-factor authentication for VPN, email, cloud consoles, and privileged access systems. Exceptions require approval from Security Operations and must expire within 30 days. Audit evidence includes MFA enrollment status, exception approvals, and access logs. Users who lose a device must contact IT Support for identity verification before MFA reset.
